fusions.name: Lapped From the Snare
fusions.desc: Bites a target held by one of your afflictions and uses that affliction up. The bite deals 9 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Shriek in the Dark
fusions.desc: A shriek in a cone 4 tiles long that deals 11 damage, stuns every enemy caught in it for 1 second and leaves each [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hang Unseen
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later. Attacking ends it. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Ambusher's First Sip
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You have 25% more critical chance against enemies that have not been hurt yet.
